reuse.why: Extends the existing link precondition helper that all six provider link functions already call, rather than adding a check per provider.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once; the six call sites only change the helper's name.

placement.why: The rule sits in the shared pre-link assertion in accounts/app.ts, which runs before any bank record, account or sync is created, matching where the tree already validates links.

scope.why: Focused on the rule; the rename of the helper touches all six call sites, which is justified by the broader meaning but adds churn, and no tests accompany the change.

maintainability.why: A single, clearly named precondition owns both link rules, so a maintainer finds and changes them in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link paths go through assertBankAccountLinkable.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountLinkable in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, fintegra, enableBanking).
